hook.command: if printf '%s' "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(^|&&|;|\|)\s*git\s+.*--(no-verify|no-gpg-sign)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: --no-verify and --no-gpg-sign flags are not allowed. Run the commit without bypass flags so that pre-commit hooks execute properly.' >&2; exit 2; fi
if printf '%s' "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(^|&&|;|\|)\s*rm\s+-rf\s+/'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Dangerous rm -rf / command detected. Use trash or remove files individually.' >&2; exit 2; fi

if printf '%s' "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(^|&&|;|\|)\s*git\s+push\s+.*--force\b' && ! printf '%s' "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(^|&&|;|\|)\s*git\s+push\s+.*--force-with-lease'; then echo 'BLOCKED: git push --force is not allowed. Use --force-with-lease for safer force pushes.' >&2; exit 2; fi

if printf '%s' "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(^|&&|;|\|)\s*git\s+reset\s+--hard'; then echo 'BLOCKED: git reset --hard is dangerous and loses uncommitted changes. Use git stash or git reset --soft instead.' >&2; exit 2; fi

if printf '%s' "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(^|&&|;|\|)\s*git\s+checkout\s+.*\s+--\s+\.'; then echo 'BLOCKED: git checkout -- . discards all uncommitted changes. Use git restore or stash changes first.' >&2; exit 2; fi

if printf '%s' "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(^|&&|;|\|)\s*git\s+clean\s+-fd'; then echo 'BLOCKED: git clean -fd removes untracked files permanently. Use git clean -fdi for interactive mode.' >&2; exit 2; fi
if printf '%s' "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(^|&&|;|\|)\s*sudo\s+'; then echo 'BLOCKED: sudo commands are not allowed. Use appropriate permissions or ask for elevated access.' >&2; exit 2; fi

if printf '%s' "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(^|&&|;|\|)\s*chmod\s+777'; then echo 'BLOCKED: chmod 777 is a security risk. Use more restrictive permissions (e.g., chmod 755 or chmod 644).' >&2; exit 2; fi
if printf '%s' "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(^|&&|;|\|)\s*curl\s+.*\|\s*(bash|sh|zsh)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Piping curl output to shell is dangerous. Download and inspect scripts first.' >&2; exit 2; fi
if printf '%s' "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(^|&&|;|\|)\s*wget\s+.*\|\s*(bash|sh|zsh)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: Piping wget output to shell is dangerous. Download and inspect scripts first.' >&2; exit 2; fi
if printf '%s' "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(^|&&|;|\|)\s*docker\s+rm\s+-f'; then echo 'BLOCKED: docker rm -f removes containers without confirmation. Use docker stop first.' >&2; exit 2; fi
if printf '%s' "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(^|&&|;|\|)\s*docker\s+rmi\s+-f'; then echo 'BLOCKED: docker rmi -f removes images without confirmation. Remove containers first.' >&2; exit 2; fi
